title: Hinomori Shizuku — Make Every Shot Count〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Raise Your Bow in a Snow-White World

rows.Line: Lunch break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Minori and Haruka said that they'll start heading over to the cafeteria in a little bit, so let's go over and claim some seats.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm very much looking forward to having lunch together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since we didn't have practice this morning, I got to walk to school with Shii today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And the snow rabbits were still there, so I decided to show her. However, she already seemed to know about them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, she saw them on her way home?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but I learned something else while talking to her that was even more surprising.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As it turns out, Shii and her friends made those other snow rabbits!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?! You mean those baby rabbits that we saw surrounding yours, Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! She was also surprised when she found out that we made those other ones.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haha! Yeah, I bet.
I would've loved to see her reaction.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm? Oh, it's Asahina.
Why don't you go say hi to her?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I'll wait right here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi!
Then, I'll be right back!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hello, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hello, Hinomori.
Can I help you? Is there something you need?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, I just wanted to thank you again for what you did the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The other day...? Oh, do you mean my umbrella?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Thank you for sharing it with me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember how I broke mine after I slipped and fell on top of it? You really saved me that time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It was nothing, really.
More importantly, are you okay? Didn't it hurt when you fell?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm okay. Hehe. It's nothing to be proud of, but it may be because I'm used to falling while practicing dance routines.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
Have you had a chance to see the snow rabbit again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Do you mean the one you made?
I did. I was wondering if it was still there on my way to school.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And I was surprised to see that there were more.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, me too!
It was so nice to see how it turned into a big family.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I didn't think about it when I made mine, but it must've felt so lonely having to sit there all by itself...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Yes...
I sort of wish that they'd never melt away.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The expression she just made. It's like the other day...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Classmate
rows.Line:
Mafuyu! Let's start eating!
I'm starving!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, be right there!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: See you later, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, of course!
See you again during archery club.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I wonder if I helped her in the end.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <If you do wish to help her, it might be good to actually say that.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <There's no way for idols to know exactly what their fans are feeling or going through, but you can tell them that they have your support...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <That sort of kindness can do wonders for a person in need.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, if there is something bothering you, I'd like for you to talk to me about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You saved me once before, Asahina.
Now it's my turn to help you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I don't know what I can do right now, but my feelings haven't changed...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So... Maybe someday...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I should return to Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Airi!
Thank you for waiting!
